definitions.explanation: A loud vocal sound produced by shouting or screaming. Can express fear, pain, excitement, or urgency.

examples.japanese: {叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The children's shouts echoed through the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}めた→覚める：02058_sameru⟧。
examples.english: A scream came from the next room late at night, and I woke up startled.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{叫|さけ}ぶ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧ (to shout/scream) and ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (voice), with ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ undergoing rendaku to become ごえ. Covers a wide range from excited shouts to terrified screams, with context determining the nature of the sound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to let out a scream
- {叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: to hear a scream
- {叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: a scream echoes
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}: a scream of terror
- ⟦{歓喜|かんき}→歓喜：13172_kanki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{叫|さけ}び{声|ごえ}: a shout of joy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧: scream — specifically a scream of fear or pain; always negative
- {怒鳴|どな}り{声|ごえ}: angry shout — specifically shouting in anger
- ⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧: cheer — specifically a positive shout of excitement or celebration
